intelligence.human_view: Three things is a law, not a list. A feed that holds anything else — a fourth kind of card, a banner, a stray control — is not a feed with an extra, it is a feed that broke its own law. The note lives where the work is: a Naya Note on a shared feed is seen by the team it is shared with, because the feed is the work's place. A project is not a fourth thing and not a separate concept — a business can be a project, a thing can be a project, a project can be its own feed, because a project IS a world you add, and a world's feed is a feed. And the one row is the discipline: kinds first (All / Smart Notes / Naya Notes / Posts), then topics, one row, never two — two rows is how the "All" filter became a second control and the glow became a defect.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your feed is a special box that holds exactly THREE kinds of treasures: Naya's notes, smart notes, and posts! Nothing else fits in the box — if it's not one of those three, it doesn't go in! And a project? A project is just a world you add — like adding a new room to your house, and that room has its own feed box! And the little filter buttons sit in ONE neat row: first the kinds (All, Smart Notes, Naya Notes, Posts), then the topics. One row, nice and tidy!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — your feed is a tidy little shelf that holds exactly three things: Naya's notes, smart notes, and posts. Nothing else goes on that shelf — if it's not one of those three, it lives somewhere else. And a project? A project is just a world you add, dear — like adding a new room to the house, and that room has its own shelf. The little filter buttons sit in one neat row: first the kinds, then the subjects. One row, nice and tidy, never two rows cluttering things up.
intelligence.naya_view: A feed is three things: Naya Notes, Smart Notes, posts. Nothing else. A project is a world you add. One filter row: kinds first, then topics. The note lives where the work is.
